title: A glossary of terms

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Define working terms so designers and commissioners can describe the same choices without ambiguity.
strategic_value: A shared glossary can reduce misunderstandings in Helsinki identity briefs and reviews.
demonstration: Expanded webpage section: a long single-column glossary pairs bold terms with definitions of identity, marks, typography, image production and printing.
practical_value: Consult a term before treating similar design or production concepts as interchangeable. The glossary’s older four-weight Helsinki Grotesk description differs from the linked 2025 six-weight Pro specimen.

content_islands.name: Identity vocabulary
content_islands.spec: The upper entries define guidelines, visual identity, wave motifs, icons and brand.

content_islands.name: Production vocabulary
content_islands.spec: Subsequent entries explain type, image and print concepts in the same term-definition structure.

reference_purposes.Application: The glossary supplies definitions for recurring terms used throughout the visual identity guidance.
